card.name: Sentence start that sets up an explanation
card.fires_on: The first word after a claim that begins an explanation, such as Why, That (before 's because), How, or The reason. It also fires on a sentence-ending period after a claim that an explanation will follow.

modes.label: Why / That's because
modes.description: A question word or 'That' opens the sentence right after a claim and leads into a because-clause.
modes.example: <<Why>>? Because it is an eight-digit palindrome

modes.label: The reason
modes.description: The word reason itself follows 'The' and introduces the cause of something just stated.
modes.example: The<< reason>> for the confusion does not originate from the

modes.label: Period before explanation
modes.description: The period ending a claim, where the next sentence will give the cause or detail.
modes.example: the radiation dose risk is higher for children than young adults<<.>> While there is no agreed upon age cut

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word reason or a because-style explanation next, in English or Chinese.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to explain why something is the case.
